key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:A266
name: count_steps_until_zero_lookup
description: Starts a counter at zero and repeatedly calls a routine with an index derived from a stored position minus the counter, incrementing the counter until that routine returns zero. It returns the number of steps taken.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:A2A2
name: scan_outward_for_exchange_count
description: Walks outward from a centre index through a table of square indices, testing occupancy and piece codes at each step and alternating two running counters. It returns the count when the scan crosses a boundary or a stop condition is met.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:A480
name: read_word_below_base_register
description: Returns the 16-bit word stored two bytes below the address held in the A5 base register. The routine is only two instructions and was reached through a decoded gap, so it may be data rather than real code.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:A488
name: check_candidate_move_flags
description: Tests a bit pattern in a flag word, looks up occupancy and piece codes in a board table for two position words, and returns a pair of values showing whether the candidate passes. Several branches compare a midpoint square against stored indices.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:A76E
name: append_record_if_below_limit
description: Copies a pair of longwords from a fixed source slot into a record table while the stored count is below eighty, then increments the count. Nothing is written once the table is full.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:A79C
name: loop_callback_indices_two_five
description: Sets a mode flag, then for each index from two through five it writes the index into a byte field and calls a routine. It clears the flag when the loop ends.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:A7C8
name: generate_piece_move_targets
description: Sets up the origin square and a mode flag, then calls a routine for up to three neighbouring squares and for a list of directional offsets walked in reverse. Each candidate square is passed to a routine that records or tests it.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:A9A2
name: dispatch_move_generation_by_mode
description: Reads a mode code from a square table entry and branches: one mode walks a fixed set of offsets, another walks ranges of offsets until a blocked square, and another steps once to a computed target. Each branch calls a routine for the squares it reaches.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:ABBE
name: scan_squares_around_midpoint
description: Clears two counters and processes each entry of one list, then tests a second list of entries. When a piece code and a count threshold hold, it scans the squares around the midpoint of two stored positions and calls a routine on each.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:AE1C
name: fetch_next_queued_pair
description: Copies the next pair from a queue table while the read position is below the write position, advancing the read position. When the queue is empty it copies a fallback pair instead.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:AE58
name: extract_lowest_bit
description: Returns the lowest bit of the low word of a 32-bit parameter as a 16-bit value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:AE68
name: compute_piece_square_score_tables
description: Totals weighted piece values for the occupied squares of both sides, then fills per-square score tables by summing shifted weights along each rank and file. The listing is truncated, so later steps are not described.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:BC08
name: count_bits_passing_test
description: Shifts a 16-bit parameter right one bit at a time until it is zero, calls a test routine for each step, and returns how many calls returned non-zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:BC36
name: compute_negated_weighted_triple
description: Reads three values from three calls and returns the negated weighted sum of them, using weights of forty, twenty and eight, packed into a 32-bit result.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:BCC4
name: lookup_strided_table_with_bonus
description: Computes a table offset from two indices using fixed row and column strides, then returns the table entry at that offset plus a per-index value from a second table.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:BD0A
name: clear_masked_bits_return_difference
description: Stores the complement of a 16-bit mask, merges bits into one table entry, clears the masked bits in the following word, and returns the difference between two routine results.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:BDE6
name: set_masked_bits_return_difference
description: Merges a 16-bit mask into a pair of table words using OR and AND operations, then clears the masked bits in the second word and returns the difference between two routine results.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:BF2C
name: evaluate_move_score_by_code
description: Chooses a scoring branch from a code byte: one code combines two lookups with direction-dependent bonuses, another weights a position difference, and the default sums two values. It applies a penalty adjustment and returns the resulting score difference.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:C198
name: run_iterative_candidate_search
description: Sets a busy flag, calls routines through two function pointers stored in the data area, and loops over candidate values until a counter limit or a stop condition. It then waits for a clear flag before clearing the busy flag.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:C300
name: check_pending_wait_condition
description: Returns zero when a pending flag is clear. Otherwise it calls a routine and returns zero when a counter is below a limit and a table entry equals one, returning one in all other cases.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:C33A
name: reset_slots_locate_side_pieces
description: Resets a table of twenty-four paired entries to a fixed source value and sets two index slots to minus one. It then scans eight squares in each of two rows and records the square of the matching piece for each side.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:C41C
name: set_flag_and_store_result
description: Sets a flag to one when a state byte is non-zero, clears a counter, and calls a routine with the parameter. It stores that routine's result only while the counter is still zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:C46E
name: analyse_timed_out_routine
description: No pseudo-code is available because the decompiler timed out, so the body cannot be described. The listing shows 122 instructions, two callers and four calls.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:C604
name: run_staged_candidate_search
description: Stores the current square pair in a list when it is occupied, then runs three stages that call routines over candidate lists. Each stage records its number, and a cutoff returns early.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:C91A
name: search_moves_with_negamax_scores
description: Records the current position in a history of up to twenty-three entries, then loops over candidate moves by swapping the side indices and recursing with the negated score. It keeps the best value and stops on a cutoff, with timing waits through stored function pointers.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:CC4A
name: insert_entry_two_slot_list
description: When the flag byte of the second parameter is non-zero and the current slot is empty or differs from the first parameter, it moves the existing entry to the second slot and writes the new pair into the first.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:CD30
name: check_pending_entry_match
description: When a mode word is set, it calls a routine on the current entry and returns one if that succeeds. Otherwise it calls the same routine on two stored entries and returns one on the first success, or zero when none succeed.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:CDEC
name: update_maximum_when_within_bound
description: Returns one when the parameter does not exceed a stored bound, and raises a stored maximum to the parameter when the parameter is larger. Otherwise it returns zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:CE26
name: score_candidate_square_stage
description: Stores a stage counter, then evaluates the candidate square for either a special stage or the normal stage. It adds score adjustments from piece codes and position thresholds, calls routines to test or undo the move, and returns zero or one for the cutoff.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:D28E
name: add_threshold_bonus_first_stage
description: At the first stage it classifies two values against thresholds of ninety-six, nineteen and two, then adds a quarter of a stored value times the matching multiplier to two score fields. It returns one at deeper stages when a counter exceeds two and a second value exceeds one.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:D374
name: save_entry_update_record_field
description: Calls a routine with a record pointer and a field offset, then copies the current entry pair into the record table. When the index is zero it saves a record field and updates it from a second field if the mode equals five.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:D3E4
name: try_codes_two_five_flag
description: Sets a flag word for the current index to one, then calls a routine for each code from two through five. It returns one as soon as a call succeeds, and clears the flag and returns zero otherwise.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:D45A
name: generate_capture_targets_for_square
description: Stores the origin square and piece code in the current record, then tests neighbouring squares and a list of directional offsets for occupied squares whose piece code is neither zero nor six. It calls routines for each candidate and returns one when a call succeeds.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:D6D2
name: enumerate_targets_by_piece_type
description: Stores the piece square and type, then branches on the type code. One type walks seven offsets, types two to four walk ranges of offsets until a blocked square, and type six computes a midpoint target and tests nearby squares, calling a routine on each candidate.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:DAF2
name: test_entries_in_reverse_order
description: Sets two state fields, then walks a stored list of entry pairs backward. It tests each pair with a routine and a second routine when the first succeeds, and returns one on the first success or zero when the list is exhausted.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:DBE6
name: scan_midpoint_neighbours_when_distant
description: When the piece code is six and a distance value exceeds thirty-one, it stores the midpoint of two positions as the current entry. It then tests the three squares around that midpoint, calling routines on each, and returns one when both tests succeed.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:DD7E
name: unwind_stack_entries_and_swap
description: Saves the current depth, then steps back to zero while swapping two side indices and calling a routine on each stored entry. A final call runs when a flag word is set.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:DDFE
name: replay_entries_forward_and_swap
description: Calls a routine on the next stored entry when a flag word is set, then increments the depth. While the depth is below the saved depth it calls a routine on each entry and swaps the two side indices.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:DE7A
name: update_message_result_flag
description: Calls two routines and an indirect routine, then stores the returned value in a flag word. When a state word is set it marks the flag if the state equals two and clears the state; the referenced text is the message 'Jay was wrong #1'.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:E084
name: apply_move_piece_special_cases
description: Applies a move between two squares, handling special cases by piece code, including a two-square relocation for one code and a rook-like step for another. It calls indirect routines to update each square and returns a packed result; the listing is truncated, so later branches are not described.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:F17C
name: store_channel_seven_eight_results
description: Calls a routine twice with a table address and the constants seven and eight, and stores each returned value in its own data field.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:F1B4
name: run_pair_when_flag_clear
description: When a flag word is zero, it calls two routines in sequence. Otherwise it returns without doing anything.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:F1D4
name: queue_channel_command_words
description: When a flag word is non-zero, it writes a fixed command-word sequence to the global output words. The sequence differs by parameter, and it contains a pointer-derived address, a stored byte and a per-channel tag, and it clears one per-channel field.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:F1EC
name: start_sound_sample_on_channel
description: Selects audio channel one or two from a per-channel field, then clears that channel's DMA bit and writes its sample address, length, period and volume from a record. It then re-enables the channel's DMA and interrupt bits.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:F248
name: start_channel_zero_sample
description: Clears a channel field, writes the DMA and interrupt control words to disable and then re-enable audio channel zero, and sets its sample address, length, period and volume from a record.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:F2A0
name: select_audio_channel_mask
description: Stores a channel number and its matching DMA enable bit in the global output words, using channel one for a zero parameter and channel two otherwise. It then calls a routine with the value two.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:F2BC
name: enable_channel_zero_dma
description: Writes the channel number one and the channel zero DMA enable bit to the global output words, then calls a routine with the value two.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:F2DA
name: enable_both_channels_set_volumes
description: Writes the DMA enable bits for both audio channels and clears two output words. It then calls a routine for volume eight and volume seven, each with a stored value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:F31A
name: initialise_sound_step_first_call
description: Sets a word to 256, then on the first call stores a pointer value and sets a count to fifty. On later calls it sets another word to 256 and a state word to two.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:F33E
name: set_sound_pointer_and_count
description: Stores a pointer value from a data field into an output slot and sets an associated count to fifty.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:F34E
name: initialise_channel_zero_sound_step
description: Sets a word to 128, then on the first call stores a pointer value and sets a count to fifty. On later calls it sets another word to 128 and a state word to one.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:F372
name: set_alternate_sound_pointer_count
description: Stores a pointer value from a data field into a second output slot and sets its associated count to fifty.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:F5DA
name: lookup_masked_channel_table_value
description: Returns zero when a record index is ninety-five or above. Otherwise it finds the first table whose mask matches a flag word, reads the entry at the record index, and sets the upper bits of the result when a flag bit is set.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:F5F2
name: lookup_table_value
description: Finds the first table whose mask matches a flag word, reads the entry at the index held in a register, and sets the upper bits of the result when a flag bit is set.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:F62A
name: initialise_trackdisk_port
description: No pseudo-code is available because the decompiler timed out, so the body cannot be described in detail. The routine references the trackdisk device name and the fatal messages about creating a disk port and accessing the drive, and calls five routines.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:F74C
name: write_word_halves_then_zero
description: Writes the two 16-bit halves of its 32-bit parameter to consecutive global output words, then writes zero to the next word.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:F76A
name: write_long_then_zero
description: Writes its 32-bit parameter to a global output word, then writes zero to the following word.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:F780
name: queue_block_transfer_in_chunks
description: Writes a requested length to output in pieces of 512 units, advancing the address and a counter after each piece. The remaining length after the full pieces is written in a final call.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:F89A
name: queue_chunk_index_sequence
description: Computes a starting index from a global counter, then for each 512-unit chunk of the requested length calls a routine with that index and the current address, advancing both.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:F8C2
name: queue_chunks_from_stored_pointers
description: Repeatedly calls a routine with two stored addresses, advancing the global counter by 512 and both addresses each pass. It also increments an index, and stops when the remaining length is exhausted.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:F8F8
name: finish_disk_request_if_pending
description: When the request word is zero and a stored handle is set, it calls two routines, then a routine with a fixed base address and the handle. Otherwise it passes the request word to a routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:F914
name: release_disk_handle_if_open
description: When a stored handle is set, it calls two routines, then a routine with a fixed base address and the handle. It does nothing when the handle is zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:F93E
name: advance_disk_block_position
description: Rounds a stored position up to the next 512-unit block and computes a block number. When the position is zero it adjusts and stores the block number; otherwise it calls a routine to transfer a 512-unit block and then stores the new position.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:FA06
name: issue_block_command_type_two
description: Writes command code two, a 512-unit length, a buffer address and a block offset (the parameter shifted by nine bits) into the command words, then calls a routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:FA3A
name: issue_block_command_type_three
description: Writes command code three, a 512-unit length, a buffer address and a block offset (the parameter shifted by nine bits) into the command words, then calls a routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:FA6C
name: retry_while_disk_write_protected
description: Repeatedly requests a status and, while the result is non-zero, calls a routine with the message 'Disk is write protected, try again.' before retrying.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:FAA4
name: forward_to_inner_routine
description: Calls one routine, which calls another, and returns. It has no logic of its own.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:FAD0
name: prompt_for_battlechess_disk
description: Waits while a status byte equals twenty-nine, and shows the message 'Insert the BattleChess disk.' whenever a request fails. After each prompt it calls a routine with the value three hundred.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:FB4C
name: probe_disk_and_restore_table
description: Copies a fixed block of longwords to a buffer, sends a request that references the title 'Battle Chess', and restores the block afterwards. It returns one when a follow-up check succeeds and zero otherwise.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:FC58
name: probe_saves_disk_restore_table
description: Copies a fixed block of longwords to a buffer, sends a request built from a computed value that references 'ChessSaves', and restores the block afterwards. It returns one when the follow-up check succeeds and zero otherwise.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:FD34
name: restore_table_and_report_success
description: Stores the request word in a frame slot, copies a fixed block from the frame into the buffer, calls a routine, and returns one.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:FD36
name: restore_table_and_clear_request

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:FFE6

name: confirm_menu_entry_clear_highlight
description: Calls a routine for the chosen entry, runs a confirmation through library calls, and clears the highlight flag for each of the eight entries.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:1023E
name: edit_text_field_mode_flag

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:10246
name: append_chars_until_return
description: Appends printable input events to a buffer up to fourteen characters and handles return by confirming the field. The terminator entry is processed as well, and the highlight flags are cleared before returning.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:1028C
name: poll_text_field_for_input
description: Polls input events for a text field and processes backspace, return, character append and cursor toggling. A terminator entry ends the routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:1028E
name: append_text_input_events
description: Appends characters from input events to a text field up to fourteen characters, handles return and backspace, and toggles the cursor in the same loop as the other field handlers.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:102C8
name: toggle_cursor_then_read_text
description: Toggles the cursor character in the text field when the cursor flag is set, then polls input events. Backspace, return and character append are handled as in the other field handlers.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:102F6
name: set_cursor_then_read_text
description: Writes the cursor character into the text field, then polls input events with the same backspace, return and append handling. A cursor already present is cleared before polling resumes.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:10320
name: clear_flag_poll_text_entry
description: Clears an entry flag, then polls input events with the same backspace, return and append handling as the other text-entry routines. The terminator entry returns.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:10328
name: run_text_entry_selection_loop
description: Polls input events for a text entry and handles backspace, return and character append. Selecting a new entry records it and redraws the cursor through library calls before the loop continues.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:1034E

description: Polls input events for a text entry, handling backspace, return and character append, and exits when the terminator entry is reached. Otherwise it keeps the current entry and continues polling.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:10390
name: poll_text_entry_events
description: Polls input events for a text entry with the same backspace, return and append handling. Terminator and selection codes are checked on each pass.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:10394
name: handle_text_entry_selection_events
description: Handles selection and text events for a text entry: a selected entry is recorded and its text is appended or removed, and the terminator entry returns. Backspace and return codes are processed as in the other text-entry routines.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:103DE
name: confirm_text_entry_with_return
description: Polls input events for a text entry and confirms the entry when the return code arrives, calling routines to record the text. The backspace code removes one character before polling resumes.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:103FC
name: restart_text_entry_selection
description: Records the selected entry, calls a routine to store its text, and sets an active flag. It then polls input events with the same backspace, return and append handling as the other text-entry routines.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:1042C
name: poll_idle_text_entry
description: Polls input events for a text entry while no entry is selected. Return confirms the text, and backspace and character append are handled as in the other text-entry routines.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:10462
name: poll_text_entry_with_selection
description: Polls input events for a text entry while an entry is selected, handling selection changes, backspace, return and character append. The terminator entry ends the routine.

name: forward_to_shared_routine
description: Calls one routine, which handles the shared text-entry step, and returns. It has no logic of its own.

name: copy_text_and_append_space
description: Calls a library routine to clear a region, copies a text string into it, and writes a space after the last character. It returns the length of the copied text.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:10540
name: check_printable_ascii_code
description: Returns one when the parameter is between thirty-two and one hundred and twenty-six inclusive, the printable ASCII range, and zero otherwise.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:1055E

description: Clears eight sixteen-byte table records and marks each with an end code. It then copies the text of every active entry into a record, stores its index, and writes the number of active entries to a count word.

description: Clears eight sixteen-byte table records and marks each with an end code. It copies every active entry into the next record along with its index, then stores the number of entries in a count word.

description: Walks the eight entry slots and copies each active entry into the next record of a table along with its slot index. It stores the number of copied entries in a count word.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:105F4

description: Clears a drawing state, sets a mode and draws a fixed-size frame. It draws a first text block when the parameter is non-zero, then a second text block; the referenced labels are 'Cancel' and 'Done'.

description: Looks up a handle using a buffer and a fixed identifier. When the handle is found it transfers a 512-byte block into the parameter buffer and releases the handle; otherwise it calls a library routine with a fixed size.

description: Looks up a handle using a buffer and a second fixed identifier. When it is found, it transfers a 512-byte block into the parameter buffer and releases the handle, and returns whether the handle was found.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:10A26

description: Clears the first byte of the buffer and, when a state word is zero, builds the save name from the stored text through a routine call. It then copies the name with a second routine; the referenced text is 'ChessSaves'.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:10A90
name: initialise_struct_and_forward
description: Clears the first fields of a record, sets a mode byte and two constant fields, then stores the third parameter in the record. It then passes the record to another routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:10AE4
name: setup_serial_port_registers
description: Opens a serial port through a library call, points its receive and transmit pointers at the start of the buffer, and writes serial period and interrupt control words.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:10B26
name: transmit_bytes_on_serial_port
description: Writes each byte of a buffer to the serial data register, waiting for the transmit-buffer-empty status bit before each byte, for the requested count.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:10B4A

description: Writes bytes from a buffer to the serial data register with a fixed data bit set, looping until the requested count is exhausted.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:10B5E
name: return_without_action
description: Returns immediately without doing anything. The routine is a three-instruction stub.

description: Reads one byte from the receive ring buffer, returning zero when the count is exhausted and minus one when the timeout expires before a byte arrives.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:10BB0
name: read_serial_bytes_with_timeout
description: Copies a counted number of bytes from the receive ring buffer into a destination, waiting for each byte up to a timeout. It returns zero when the count is met and minus one on timeout.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:10BDE
name: return_negative_one

name: receive_serial_bytes_into_buffer
description: Receives a counted block of bytes from the receive ring buffer into a destination, with a timeout for each byte. It returns zero on success and minus one when the timeout expires.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:10BEA
name: return_zero

name: reset_receive_ring_pointer
description: Sets the receive buffer read pointer equal to its write pointer, discarding any unread bytes.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:10BFC
name: count_unread_serial_bytes
description: Returns the number of bytes waiting in the receive ring buffer, adding the buffer size of one hundred and twenty-eight when the write position is behind the read position.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:10C1E
name: compute_serial_ring_offset
description: Computes the distance from the read pointer to a stored position inside the one-hundred-and-twenty-eight-byte ring buffer, adding the buffer size for wrap-around.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:10C36
name: enable_serial_receive_interrupt
description: Sets an interrupt control word and calls a library routine with the serial port identifier eleven and the stored port handle.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:10C54
name: queue_serial_transmit_byte
description: Writes a byte into the transmit ring buffer at the write pointer, advances the pointer, and wraps it to the buffer start at the end. It also sets a control word.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:10C7E
name: send_packet_with_ack_retries
description: Computes a two-byte checksum over a packet, sends the packet and waits for an acknowledgement byte for up to five attempts. A timeout clears the packet, and a reply that is neither an acknowledgement nor a retry marker reports an error.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:10CAC
name: resend_packet_until_acknowledged
description: Computes a checksum over the outgoing packet and sends it, then checks replies for acknowledgement markers. Timeouts and unknown replies are handled by clearing the packet or reporting an error.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:10D08
name: wait_for_packet_acknowledgement
description: Waits for an acknowledgement byte, accepting the acknowledgement or retry markers. A timeout clears the packet, an unknown byte reports an error, and after four retries a timeout message is shown.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:10D2C
name: retry_on_simultaneous_send
description: Checks received bytes against acknowledgement markers and retries the send when the reply indicates both sides transmitted at once; the referenced text is 'Sending at the same time...try again'. Failure after the retry limit is reported through a message routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:10D4C
name: wait_for_opponent_reply
description: Makes up to five attempts to read a reply, checking each byte for acknowledgement markers and clearing the buffer on timeout. When the attempts run out it reports the referenced text 'Opponent not responding'.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:10DBA
name: handle_modem_command_line
description: Reads a line from the serial port into a buffer, replacing unprintable bytes, and checks for the command text 'ATE'. Depending on the first byte it sends an acknowledgement or sets a state flag, and it returns minus one when the line is rejected.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:10E42
name: exchange_modem_packets_until_done
description: Computes a checksum over a received packet and compares it with the expected trailer bytes. It answers with an acknowledgement or a command line, and loops until a stop status is reached or a reply has been sent.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:10E72
name: handshake_modem_packet_exchange
description: Sets a state flag, reads input, and checks each packet's checksum trailer. It breaks out on the acknowledgement code and otherwise returns zero, and it checks the 'ATE' command text on command lines.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:10E7A
name: send_modem_status_check_trailer
description: Sends a four-byte status header chosen by a state flag, then reads a packet and checks its checksum trailer. It repeats until the packet is acknowledged or the reading fails.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:10E88
name: send_status_header_await_packet
description: Sends a status header chosen by a state value, then waits for a packet and verifies its checksum trailer. The loop ends on the acknowledgement code and returns zero for an unknown packet type.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:10EA2
name: return_zero_value
description: Returns zero without any other operation.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:10EAC
name: dispatch_modem_packet_by_type
description: Branches on the packet type code: the first type sends a status header chosen by a state flag, the second sets a flag, and other types return zero. It then reads the next packet and verifies its checksum trailer.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:10EBA
name: wait_for_modem_packet_reply
description: Waits for a reply packet and sends a status header for the first type code or sets a flag for the second. Other codes return zero, and the checksum trailer is verified before the loop continues.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:10EC6
name: resume_modem_packet_loop
description: Sets a state flag, then reads packets and verifies their checksum trailers. A valid packet is answered with a status header or a flag change, unknown codes return zero, and a missing input returns minus one.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:10ED2
name: poll_modem_packets_length_limit
description: Polls for packets with a length field below forty. Each valid packet is checked against its checksum trailer and answered with a status header or a flag change, and the loop ends when the length check fails.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:10EDA
name: process_modem_line_then_packets
description: Replaces unprintable bytes in a received line and checks it for the command text 'ATE'. It then reads packets and verifies their checksum trailers, answering with a status header or a flag change.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:10F12
name: read_modem_line_into_buffer
description: Clears a destination byte, polls for input, and copies received text into the buffer, checking each packet's checksum trailer. Command lines are checked for the 'ATE' text.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:10F4C
name: receive_modem_packet_loop
description: Sets a flag and polls for packets, verifying checksum trailers and answering with status headers. Received lines are cleaned as in the other modem routines, and the routine returns minus one on timeout.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:10F62
name: send_status_pair_if_active
description: When either of two status fields equals two, it builds a two-byte message with the codes one hundred and sixty-one and thirty-seven and sends it through a routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:10FA6
name: send_extracted_byte_packet
description: Builds a six-byte packet from a type code, a length of six and two bytes read from the source record, then passes the packet to a routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:10FEA
name: send_constant_command
description: Places two constant bytes, one hundred and sixty-nine and five, on the stack and passes a pointer to them to a routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:1101E
name: send_connect_header_clear_flag
description: Sends the four-byte header for the first status code through a routine, then clears the state flag.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:11040
name: fill_buffer_with_count
description: Writes successive counter values as bytes into a buffer, counting down from the given length minus one to zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:11054
name: advance_random_seed_high_bits
description: Calls a routine, adds twelve thousand three hundred and forty-five to the result, stores it as the seed, and returns the upper fifteen bits.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:11088
name: store_seed_high_word
description: Stores the upper sixteen bits of a 32-bit parameter into a seed field.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:1109A
name: convert_to_uppercase
description: Converts a lowercase ASCII letter to uppercase by subtracting thirty-two and returns the byte. Other values are returned unchanged.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:110B2
name: convert_to_lowercase
description: Converts an uppercase ASCII letter to lowercase by adding thirty-two and returns the byte. Other values are returned unchanged.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:110CA
name: open_dos_library_or_alert
description: Clears a block of longwords in the data area and stores the system base. It opens the 'dos.library' by name and calls a failure routine when that fails, otherwise it calls another routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:1113C
name: return_immediately
description: Returns without doing anything; the body is a single return.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:11144
name: allocate_named_record_block
description: Allocates a cleared block sized from a stored count times six bytes and initialises its flag and index fields. It writes a four-character tag into a list entry, then calls another routine and frees the block if allocation fails.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:1127A
name: parse_quoted_arguments_into_table
description: Splits a command string into space-separated arguments, honouring double quotes, and copies each argument into a buffer. It records a pointer to each argument in a table that ends with a null pointer.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:1127C
name: parse_command_line_arguments
description: Splits a command string into arguments with quote handling and copies them into a buffer. It then builds a table of argument pointers, terminated by a null pointer, using several library calls.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:1142C
name: copy_bounded_string_padded
description: Copies bytes from a source string up to a count or the null terminator, then fills the remaining count with zero bytes. The return value is the destination pointer.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:1142E
name: copy_string_pad_zeros
description: Copies bytes from a source string up to a count or the null terminator, then fills any remaining count with zero bytes. It returns the destination pointer.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:11450
name: safe_memory_copy
description: Copies a counted block of bytes from a source to a destination. It copies backwards when the destination lies above the source, so overlapping regions are preserved.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:1147A
name: append_string_to_end
description: Finds the end of the destination string and appends the source string, stopping at a limit of about thirty-two thousand bytes and writing a terminator.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:11480
name: append_string_with_limit
description: Appends bytes from a source string to the end of a destination string, stopping at the null terminator or when the count expires. It writes a terminator if the copy stopped before the source ended.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:114A4
name: compare_two_byte_strings
description: Compares two byte strings up to about thirty-two thousand bytes. It returns minus one when the first is smaller, one when it is larger, and zero when they are equal or both end.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:114D4
name: copy_string_to_buffer
description: Copies a zero-terminated byte string into a buffer including its terminator and returns the original destination pointer.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:114E4
name: multiply_32_bit_values
description: Multiplies two 32-bit values by splitting each into 16-bit halves and summing the cross products. It returns the 64-bit product as a pair of longwords.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:11508
name: open_icon_library_for_window
description: Looks up a window through a library call and reads a record from its structure using the 'icon.library' name. When the record is found it stores its fields, and it closes the library handle afterwards.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:115BA
name: read_timer_value
description: Opens a timer request, reads the elapsed time, and closes the request. It returns the sum of two timer values and stores the result through the optional pointer.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:115BC
name: read_timer_value_with_message
description: Reads the timer the same way as the other timer routine and returns the sum of two timer values. The referenced text 'timer is not available' is used when the timer device cannot be opened.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:11672
name: perform_signed_division
description: Divides two signed inputs through a called routine, negating the quotient when the input signs differ. It returns a 32-bit value combined from the quotient and the second input.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:1169A
name: negate_quotient_by_sign
description: Calls a routine and negates the returned value when the first input is negative. It returns a 32-bit value combined from the result and the second input.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:116B4
name: call_and_return_concatenated
description: Calls another routine and returns a 64-bit value built from the second register value and the register left by that call.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:116C0
name: call_and_return_unchanged
description: Calls another routine and returns, with no other operation.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:116CA
name: divide_unsigned_32_by_32
description: Divides an unsigned 32-bit value by a second value, using a bit-by-bit loop when the divisor exceeds sixteen bits and a direct 16-bit division otherwise. It returns the quotient and the remainder as a pair.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:116F4
name: run_division_loop_no_result
description: Runs a bit-by-bit division loop on the swapped halves of the divisor and updates the working register values. It returns no result.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:1171A
name: compute_string_length
description: Walks a zero-terminated byte string to its terminator and returns the number of bytes before it. It does not modify memory.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:1172C
name: invoke_optional_callback
description: Calls a stored callback pointer when it is set, then calls another routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:1174A
name: release_record_buffers
description: Releases each entry of a record table and frees the table buffer sized by an entry count times six bytes. It also releases three optional handles when they are set and calls routines for the stored list entries.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:11764
name: release_records_under_supervisor
description: Calls a routine for each record and frees the record buffer, then releases optional handles. It checks an exec flag through a supervisor call before freeing the list entries.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:117E4
name: flush_pending_list_entries
description: When a pending list pointer is zero, it calls a routine with the stored pointer and length. Otherwise it calls a routine on the stored list pointer.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:1181A
name: release_pending_list_entry
description: Calls a routine, then calls another routine on the stored pending list pointer, and returns the stored result.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:11832
name: return_empty_routine
description: Returns with no action. The routine is a three-instruction stub.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:11838
name: release_indexed_record
description: Checks that a record index is within range and that its entry is set; a failure stores an error code and returns minus one. Otherwise it releases the entry's buffer unless a flag bit is set, clears the entry, and returns zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:1186E
name: release_record_entry_by_flag
description: Releases the stored value of a record when its flag bit is clear, then clears the record and returns zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:11884
name: dispatch_through_stored_pointer
description: Calls a routine through a function pointer read from a stored field, offset by minus thirty-six bytes. The listing has no recovered jump table, so the target is not known.
